testContextNative.socketPath.description: Absolute test-context daemon socket path. Empty uses TCTX_HOME or ~/.local/state/test-context/daemon.sock.

testContextNative.autoStartService.description: Start test-context.service through systemctl --user when the daemon socket is unavailable.

testContextNative.wslDistribution.description: Windows extension hosts: WSL distribution running the shared tctx daemon.

testContextNative.wslExecutablePath.description: Windows extension hosts: absolute Linux tctx executable supporting native-bridge.

testContextNative.autoRegisterWorkspace.description: Automatically register trusted Python workspaces on the first native test tool lookup.

testContextNative.executablePath.description: Absolute tctx executable path used for workspace registration. Empty uses ~/.local/bin/tctx.

testContextNative.requestTimeoutMs.description: Native tool request timeout in milliseconds.

languageModelTools.name: test-context-native_testRun
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this FIRST instead of running shell pytest, cargo test, vitest, jest, or node --test in a registered workspace. Resolves target test files or expands modified Python, Rust, or Frontend (TS/JS/JSX/TSX/Vue/Svelte/CSS/SCSS) source files through the polyglot AST reverse dependency graph, verifies live SHA-256 Merkle dependency hashes (dep_hash), skips tests that already passed in the background worker, joins in-flight background runs, and runs only the uncached delta. Returns instant results (< 5ms) when all targeted tests are already cached green.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run pytest, cargo test, vitest, jest, and node --test incrementally using the AST dependency graph and background test cache.

root.description: Optional absolute registered workspace/worktree root. Always pass explicitly when known (especially in subagents, Windows/WSL Agent Sessions, and multi-root setups); omit for the current workspace.

targets.description: Optional relative test file paths, test directories, test nodeids (path::test_name), or modified Python/Rust/Frontend source file paths. Omit to target all workspace tests.

rerun_failed.description: Re-run tests whose cached result for the current dep_hash was failed.

no_cache.description: Bypass cached pass results and force test execution.

ruff_fix.description: Auto-fix safe Ruff/ESLint lint and import issues (ruff check --fix / eslint --fix) on targeted files before running tests.

pytest_args.description: Optional additional test runner CLI flags.

languageModelTools.name: test-context-native_testAffected
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this FIRST to discover which Python (pytest), Rust (cargo test), or Frontend (Vitest/Jest/Node/Storybook) test files are impacted by modified source files or git working-tree changes via the AST reverse dependency graph, along with each test file's dependency chain, live background cache status (cached_passed, cached_failed, running_in_background, queued_in_background, uncached), and pre-checked Ruff/ESLint diagnostics.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find Python, Rust, and Frontend test files affected by source changes and inspect their background cache and lint status.

files.description: Optional relative paths of modified Python, Rust, Frontend, stylesheet, or config files. Omit to use git dirty files when git_diff=true.

git_diff.description: Use git working-tree dirty files when files is empty.

languageModelTools.name: test-context-native_testGraph
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect the AST dependency graph for a specific Python, Rust, or Frontend (TS/JS/JSX/TSX/Vue/Svelte/CSS/SCSS) source or test file: direct imports, reverse importers, transitive dependencies, conftest.py / tests/common / setupTests.ts chains, affected test files, test symbols, fixtures, and Merkle dep_hash.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect the Python, Rust, or Frontend AST import and fixture dependency graph for a file.

file.description: Relative path to the Python, Rust, or Frontend file within the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: test-context-native_testStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show test-context daemon health and workspace residency immediately. Set load=true to load an inactive graph for detailed AST, cache, queue, and saved-time counts.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show test-context daemon and background cache status.

load.description: Load an inactive workspace graph for detailed counts. False returns registered/unloaded state immediately.

languageModelTools.name: test-context-native_testSync
languageModelTools.displayName: Test Context: Sync AST & Background Queue
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Synchronize the Python AST dependency graph with saved files on disk and queue any uncached or modified tests for background execution. Set wait=true to wait for background execution to finish.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Synchronize the Python AST dependency graph and trigger background test runs.

wait.description: Wait for queued background test runs to finish before returning.

languageModelTools.name: test-context-native_testInvalidate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Invalidate cached test results for specific test/source files (or the entire workspace when files is omitted) and schedule background re-execution.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Invalidate cached pytest results and trigger background re-execution.

files.description: Optional relative test or source file paths to invalidate. Omit to invalidate all cached results in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: test-context-native_testWorkspaces
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List explicitly registered test-context workspace roots, scopes, globs, and detected pytest commands.
